sloka: अङ्गदाभिहतास्तत्र राक्षसा भीमविक्रमाः ।विभिन्नशिरसः पेतुर्विकृत्ता इव पादपाः ।। ६.५३.२९ ।।िव ।।।
transliteration: aṅgadābhihatāstatra rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ ।vibhinnaśirasaḥ peturvikṛttā iva pādapāḥ ।। 6.53.29 ।।iva ।।।

translations.english: Heroic Angada, equal to Indra in prowess, enraged, eyes turned red in anger, seizing a tree made a fierce fight with Rakshasa army like a lion with small animals.
